violation_type.title: Janitorial duties (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(C))
violation_type.typical_finding: There is sufficient evidence to show that a caregiver was preoccupied with cleaning windows inside the classroom and not engaged with the child.

finding_variants.text: There is sufficient evidence to show that a caregiver was preoccupied with cleaning windows inside the classroom and not engaged with the child.
There was sufficient evidence found during the investigation to show that caregivers were completing janitorial duties while responsible for the supervision of children.
It was found a caregiver was engaged in cleaning the classroom when they were responsible for a group of children in care.
A caregiver was vacuuming the carpet while children were in the group and no other caregiver was present the classroom. The children were participating in an art activity quietly at the table.
Caregiver was observed sweeping the playground, while supervising a group of children.

Based on the information obtained from the DFPS investigation, the bus driver failed to properly supervise the child in care, as the bus driver was cleaning the bus while attempting to supervise the child at the same time.
